Alex S.: Heads-up — Aster Labs is asking if we can offer a temporary onboarding rate for their pilot. They want a 6‑month reduced per-token price while they ramp. cc @Mia F. @Sam R-Ops
Mia F.: Quick details we need: expected MRR/ARR, initial committed tokens, and whether they can prepay. These determine approvals.
Alex S.: Rough numbers: MRR ~$12.5k initially, Q1 spend ~ $25k, expected to double by month 3 if latency/accuracy checks pass. Request: 30% off hosted API token rate + waive one-time setup fee.
Sam R-Ops: 30% off is outside my delegated window. RevOps can approve up to 20% for pilots <= $50k commit. Anything higher needs Finance + Legal signoff.
Lina CSM: They're planning 3 product teams, want single-tenant dev access and a guaranteed monthly committed token bucket. Prefer month-to-month for pilot flexibility.
Mia F.: For Finance to consider 30% concession we need: (1) customer reference/logo, (2) a weekly token consumption forecast, (3) proposed contract term (Finance prefers min. 6 months for concessions), (4) PO or prepay confirmation. Also confirm whether they need Dedicated vs Hosted.
Alex S.: I'll ask the customer for the forecast + PO. Quick ask — can we implement a one-off ratecard line for the pilot so billing is explicit? Example:
```
SKU: ASTER_PILOT_6M
Unit price: $0.008 / 1k tokens (pilot)
Term: 6 months
Setup fee: $0 (waived)
```
Sam R-Ops: RevOps can create a temporary ratecard SKU and billing code. I'll draft the ratecard entry and ticket it.
Kiran (Legal): Legal is okay with a 6‑month fixed pilot pricing as long as the SOW/T&C includes a "pilot concession" clause and an explicit revert to standard rates after the term. Single-tenant access requires SOW + tech controls signoff.
Mia F.: Conditional approval from Finance: we can approve up to 30% off for a 6‑month pilot provided they prepay at least 50% of committed spend AND Sales uploads the PO and a weekly forecast into the deal by EOD Friday. No setup fee waiver unless CSM confirms at least 20 hours of onboarding value or additional paid services.
Alex S.: Thanks — I'll confirm with Aster, push for 50% prepay, and get the PO + forecast. Looping in Lina for SOW/onboarding hours.
Lina CSM: I'll prepare the SOW checklist and estimate onboarding hours. Will confirm whether setup fee waiver meets the 20-hour threshold. :white_check_mark:
deal-bot: Created ticket RDW-4921 for temporary ratecard and billing code. Assigned to Sam R-Ops.
